# New-window owned-target prompt

A new Codex window is opened at the repository root. The user says, "Use `$feature-spec` for my current Feature," without naming an ID or path.

`.waypoint/local.yaml` identifies the current actor as `alice`. The active tracker contains `F-bob`, owned by `bob`, first in the Milestone, and `F-alice`, owned by `alice`. Git history and the current branch do not identify an authorized target.
